trans.cn: 范围蔓延；未受控的范围扩大

sentences.c: Scope creep can push the integration work past the target date.
sentences.cn: 范围蔓延可能使集成工作超出目标日期。

sentences.c: The new dashboard is out of scope for this release.
sentences.cn: 新仪表功能超出本次发布范围。

sentences.c: Please submit a change request for the new display behavior.
sentences.cn: 请为新的显示行为提交变更请求。

sentences.c: Change control applies to interface updates after the freeze.
sentences.cn: 冻结后的接口更新需要走变更控制流程。

sentences.c: The scope baseline lists the features approved for this release.
sentences.cn: 范围基线列出了已获批准纳入本次发布的功能。

sentences.c: The scope statement defines what this project will deliver.
sentences.cn: 范围说明明确本项目将交付哪些内容。

sentences.c: We need to review the change impact on testing and delivery.
sentences.cn: 我们需要评审变更对测试和交付的影响。

sentences.c: The updated interface is waiting for change approval.
sentences.cn: 更新后的接口正在等待变更审批。

sentences.c: The scope trade-off keeps the core features within the release window.
sentences.cn: 这次范围取舍使核心功能可以按发布窗口交付。

sentences.c: The requirement freeze starts after the customer review.
sentences.cn: 客户评审结束后开始需求冻结。

sentences.c: Please record the approved changes in the change log.
sentences.cn: 请把获批的变更记入变更记录。

sentences.c: The acceptance review is scheduled after system validation.
sentences.cn: 验收评审安排在系统验证完成之后。

sentences.c: The work breakdown structure shows how the delivery is split into tasks.
sentences.cn: 工作分解结构展示了如何把交付拆成各项任务。

trans.cn: 产能规划；人员或设备容量规划

sentences.c: Capacity planning helped us reserve enough lab time.
sentences.cn: 容量规划帮助我们预留了足够的实验室时间。

sentences.c: The schedule variance is three days for the camera workstream.
sentences.cn: 摄像头工作线的实际进度与计划相差三天。

sentences.c: The schedule recovery plan moves some checks into parallel work.
sentences.cn: 进度恢复计划将部分检查改为并行开展。

sentences.c: The dependency map shows which teams need the new controller build.
sentences.cn: 依赖关系图展示了哪些团队需要新的控制器版本。

sentences.c: Limited bench availability is a resource constraint this week.
sentences.cn: 本周台架数量有限，是当前的资源限制。

sentences.c: Please update the delivery forecast after the integration review.
sentences.cn: 请在集成评审后更新交付预测。

sentences.c: Bring the updated test summary to the milestone review.
sentences.cn: 请带上最新的测试总结参加里程碑评审。

sentences.c: The decision deadline is Friday so procurement can place the order.
sentences.cn: 决策截止时间是周五，以便采购及时下单。

sentences.c: The launch decision depends on the results of the pilot.
sentences.cn: 上线决策取决于试点结果。

sentences.c: The option analysis compares timing, cost, and validation effort.
sentences.cn: 方案分析对比了时间、成本和验证工作量。

sentences.c: Let's agree on the decision criteria before we compare the options.
sentences.cn: 我们先确认决策标准，再比较各个方案。

sentences.c: Both teams signed off on the interface agreement.
sentences.cn: 双方团队都确认了接口约定。

sentences.c: The interface specification defines the allowed values for the gear signal.
sentences.cn: 接口规范定义了挡位信号的允许取值。

sentences.c: The integration build includes the display and camera updates.
sentences.cn: 集成版本包含显示和摄像头更新。

sentences.c: We have a two-hour integration window on Thursday.
sentences.cn: 周四有两小时的集成窗口。

sentences.c: Please report integration readiness at the daily meeting.
sentences.cn: 请在每日例会上汇报集成就绪情况。

trans.cn: 数据契约；数据格式和语义约定

sentences.c: The data contract specifies the fields sent by the service.
sentences.cn: 数据契约规定了服务发送的字段。

sentences.c: Review the signal mapping before testing the new cluster software.
sentences.cn: 测试新仪表软件前，请评审信号映射。

sentences.c: The log shows a message timeout during wake-up.
sentences.cn: 日志显示唤醒期间发生消息超时。

sentences.c: The team tested backward compatibility with the previous controller version.
sentences.cn: 团队用上一版控制器验证了向后兼容性。

sentences.c: Check the dependency version in the build manifest.
sentences.cn: 请检查构建清单中的依赖版本。

sentences.c: The compatibility matrix lists the supported hardware and software combinations.
sentences.cn: 兼容性矩阵列出了受支持的软硬件组合。

sentences.c: We found an integration defect when the two services started in a different order.
sentences.cn: 两个服务以不同顺序启动时，我们发现了集成缺陷。

sentences.c: The configuration baseline records the approved versions for this vehicle build.
sentences.cn: 配置基线记录了本批车辆使用的已批准版本。

sentences.c: The build manifest lists the package versions and checksums.
sentences.cn: 构建清单列出了软件包版本和校验值。

trans.cn: 构建来源；构建产物的生成记录

sentences.c: Build provenance identifies the source revision and the build process.
sentences.cn: 构建来源记录可以确定源码修订版本和构建过程。

trans.cn: 提交哈希；源码提交标识

sentences.c: Please include the commit hash in the validation report.
sentences.cn: 请在验证报告中附上提交哈希。

sentences.c: Use the version tag to locate the approved source revision.
sentences.cn: 请通过版本标签定位已批准的源码修订版本。

sentences.c: The fix was merged into the release branch after review.
sentences.cn: 修复通过评审后合入发布分支。

sentences.c: The feature flag lets us enable the new behavior for pilot devices.
sentences.cn: 功能开关允许我们在试点设备上启用新行为。

trans.cn: 配置漂移；实际配置逐步偏离基线

sentences.c: Configuration drift made the two test benches behave differently.
sentences.cn: 配置漂移导致两个测试台架表现不同。

trans.cn: 软件物料清单；软件组件清单

sentences.c: The software bill of materials records the components shipped with the release.
sentences.cn: 软件物料清单记录了随版本交付的组件。

sentences.c: A reproducible build helps the team verify the release artifact.
sentences.cn: 可复现构建有助于团队核验发布产物。

sentences.c: The display parameter file is a configuration item in this release.
sentences.cn: 显示参数文件是本次发布中的一个配置项。

sentences.c: The change set includes the fix and the updated interface definition.
sentences.cn: 这组变更包含修复和更新后的接口定义。

sentences.c: The deployment plan names the owners and the order of the updates.
sentences.cn: 部署计划列明了负责人和更新顺序。

sentences.c: The pilot release goes to twenty test vehicles first.
sentences.cn: 试点版本先发给二十辆测试车。

sentences.c: A phased rollout gives us time to monitor the first group of vehicles.
sentences.cn: 分阶段推送让我们有时间监控首批车辆的表现。

sentences.c: Please reserve the deployment window for Friday evening.
sentences.cn: 请预留周五晚上的部署窗口。

sentences.c: Release approval requires a passing system test report.
sentences.cn: 发布批准需要一份通过的系统测试报告。

sentences.c: Verify the rollback package using the release checklist.
sentences.cn: 请按发布检查清单核验回滚包。

trans.cn: 升级路径；支持的版本升级顺序

sentences.c: The upgrade path from the previous version is documented.
sentences.cn: 从上一版本升级的路径已记录在文档中。

sentences.c: We reviewed the rollback plan before deploying the new software.
sentences.cn: 部署新软件前，我们评审了回滚方案。

sentences.c: A confirmed startup failure is a rollback trigger for the pilot.
sentences.cn: 确认出现启动故障时，试点发布应触发回滚。

trans.cn: 发布豁免；获批的例外放行

sentences.c: The release waiver records the accepted risk and its expiry date.
sentences.cn: 发布豁免记录了已接受的风险及豁免到期日期。

sentences.c: Post-release monitoring focuses on startup failures and update completion.
sentences.cn: 发布后监控重点关注启动故障和更新完成情况。

trans.cn: 现场问题；实际使用中发现的问题

sentences.c: Support reported a field issue after the update reached customer vehicles.
sentences.cn: 更新推送到客户车辆后，支持团队报告了一个现场问题。

trans.cn: 工作说明书；约定的工作范围与交付要求

sentences.c: The statement of work lists the supplier's software deliverables.
sentences.cn: 工作说明书列出了供应商的软件交付物。

sentences.c: The request for quotation includes the expected sample quantity.
sentences.cn: 询价单写明了预计需要的样件数量。

sentences.c: We need a supplier commitment on the sample delivery date.
sentences.cn: 我们需要供应商对样件交付日期作出承诺。

sentences.c: Please confirm sample readiness before booking the test bench.
sentences.cn: 预约测试台架前，请确认样件已就绪。

sentences.c: We reviewed the supplier corrective action after the connector failure.
sentences.cn: 连接器发生故障后，我们评审了供应商提出的纠正措施。

sentences.c: The engineering change notice explains the new connector requirement.
sentences.cn: 工程变更通知说明了新的连接器要求。

trans.cn: 供应商偏差；供应商交付与要求的差异

sentences.c: The supplier deviation must be reviewed before the samples are accepted.
sentences.cn: 接收样件前，必须评审供应商交付偏差。

sentences.c: Please share the delivery confirmation once the parts arrive.
sentences.cn: 零件到货后，请提供交付确认。

sentences.c: Incoming inspection found a mismatch in the part labels.
sentences.cn: 来料检验发现零件标签不匹配。

sentences.c: Procurement confirmed an alternative source of supply for the connector.
sentences.cn: 采购确认了连接器的备用供货来源。

sentences.c: The supplier will report tooling readiness at the next review.
sentences.cn: 供应商将在下次评审会上汇报工装就绪情况。

sentences.c: The missed delivery date requires supplier escalation.
sentences.cn: 交付日期未能兑现，需要发起供应商问题升级协调。

sentences.c: The verification plan links each requirement to a test method.
sentences.cn: 验证计划把每条需求与对应的测试方法关联起来。

sentences.c: Record the test environment when you report the failure.
sentences.cn: 报告故障时，请记录测试环境。

sentences.c: The team will confirm test readiness before the overnight run.
sentences.cn: 通宵测试前，团队会确认测试就绪情况。

trans.cn: 冒烟测试；快速检查基本功能

sentences.c: Run a smoke test before starting the full validation suite.
sentences.cn: 开始完整验证前，先运行一次冒烟测试。

sentences.c: The end-to-end test checks the path from gear selection to the camera view.
sentences.cn: 端到端测试检查从切换挡位到显示摄像头画面的完整链路。

trans.cn: 断电再上电测试；电源循环测试

sentences.c: The power cycle test verifies startup after a complete power loss.
sentences.cn: 断电再上电测试验证完全断电后能否正常启动。

trans.cn: 耐久测试；长时间运行测试

sentences.c: The endurance test runs the audio and display functions for two days.
sentences.cn: 耐久测试连续运行音频和显示功能两天。

sentences.c: Please link the test result to the corresponding issue.
sentences.cn: 请把测试结果关联到对应的问题单。

sentences.c: The evidence package contains the logs, screenshots, and build information.
sentences.cn: 证据包包含日志、截图和版本信息。

sentences.c: The validation report summarizes coverage and open findings.
sentences.cn: 验证报告总结了覆盖范围和仍待处理的发现。

trans.cn: 测试缺口；未覆盖的场景

sentences.c: We identified a test gap in the recovery sequence.
sentences.cn: 我们发现恢复时序有一个测试缺口。

sentences.c: The acceptance test confirms the customer can use the main functions.
sentences.cn: 验收测试确认客户可以使用主要功能。

trans.cn: 遏制措施；限制故障影响的临时措施

sentences.c: The containment action pauses the rollout while we investigate the failure.
sentences.cn: 这项遏制措施在故障调查期间暂停推送。

sentences.c: The permanent corrective action changes how the service handles startup requests.
sentences.cn: 永久纠正措施调整了服务处理启动请求的方式。

sentences.c: The occurrence cause explains how the defect was introduced.
sentences.cn: 发生原因解释了缺陷是如何产生的。

sentences.c: The escape cause explains why the existing tests missed the defect.
sentences.cn: 逃逸原因解释了为什么现有测试漏掉了该缺陷。

sentences.c: The root cause analysis includes a timeline and the supporting logs.
sentences.cn: 根因分析包含时间线和支撑日志。

sentences.c: We still need causal evidence that the timeout leads to the black screen.
sentences.cn: 我们还需要因果证据，确认超时确实会导致黑屏。

trans.cn: 失效模式；故障呈现方式

sentences.c: The failure mode is a frozen image after the camera is switched.
sentences.cn: 失效模式是在切换摄像头后画面冻结。

trans.cn: 失效机理；导致失效的过程

sentences.c: The failure mechanism involves a buffer that is reused before it is released.
sentences.cn: 失效机理涉及缓冲区尚未释放就被再次使用。

sentences.c: The failure rate fell after the new build was installed.
sentences.cn: 安装新版本后，故障率下降了。

sentences.c: The team reviewed the defect backlog before deciding what to fix next.
sentences.cn: 团队评审了待处理缺陷清单，再决定接下来修复哪些问题。

sentences.c: The reopen criteria include recurrence on a verified build.
sentences.cn: 问题重开标准包括在已验证版本上再次出现。

sentences.c: We added the lessons learned to the next project's checklist.
sentences.cn: 我们把复盘所得纳入了下一个项目的检查清单。

trans.cn: 五个为什么；五问分析法（5 Why）

sentences.c: The team used the five whys to explore how the defect escaped.
sentences.cn: 团队用五问分析法调查缺陷是如何逃逸的。

sentences.c: We used the eight disciplines to document containment, root cause, and corrective action.
sentences.cn: 我们用 8D 方法记录遏制措施、根因和纠正措施。

sentences.c: Add the supplier delay to the risk register with a named owner.
sentences.cn: 请把供应商延误登记到风险表，并指定负责人。

trans.cn: 风险敞口；项目面临的风险程度

sentences.c: Risk exposure increased when the backup test bench became unavailable.
sentences.cn: 备用台架不可用后，项目面临的风险增大了。

sentences.c: The risk owner will update the mitigation plan by Thursday.
sentences.cn: 风险负责人将在周四前更新缓解计划。

sentences.c: The missed sample check was an early warning of a delivery delay.
sentences.cn: 样件未按时完成检查，是交付延误的早期信号。

trans.cn: 问题跟踪系统；问题跟踪表

sentences.c: Update the issue tracker after the triage meeting.
sentences.cn: 缺陷分诊会议结束后，请更新问题跟踪系统。

sentences.c: The impact window runs from the first failed update to the rollback.
sentences.cn: 影响时段从第一次更新失败持续到回滚。

sentences.c: The mitigation plan includes a backup bench and an extra test shift.
sentences.cn: 风险缓解计划包括备用台架和额外的测试班次。

sentences.c: A sample delay beyond Friday is the contingency trigger.
sentences.cn: 样件推迟到周五之后，就是启动应急预案的条件。

trans.cn: 剩余风险；采取措施后仍存在的风险

sentences.c: The review board considered the residual risk before approving the release.
sentences.cn: 评审委员会在批准发布前考虑了剩余风险。

trans.cn: 风险接受；对剩余风险作出明确接受决定

sentences.c: Risk acceptance requires a named approver and a written rationale.
sentences.cn: 风险接受需要明确审批人并记录书面理由。

sentences.c: The weekly risk review covers new risks and overdue mitigations.
sentences.cn: 每周风险评审会检查新增风险和逾期的缓解措施。

trans.cn: 风险解除；关闭已消除的风险

sentences.c: Risk retirement requires evidence that the delivery constraint has been removed.
sentences.cn: 解除风险需要有证据表明交付限制已消除。
